name: So
summary: Sò is one of the shellfish the Tiền Giang provincial portal calls characteristic at the Mỹ Tho pier court. The 5 Jan 2019 article prints no species, no cooking method, and no price.
origin: The pier court on đường 30 Tháng 4. The Tiền Giang provincial portal, 5 Jan 2019, names sò with nghêu and dried seafood.
howToEat: The portal names sò and prints no species and no method.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival.
where: Inside the tourist-boat pier on đường 30 Tháng 4, old phường 1. The 5 Jan 2019 article prints 18:30–02:00. Viet Fun Travel prints a night market at số 8 đường 30/4 from 18:00, busiest 19:00–22:00. The two clocks do not match.
seoTitle: So at the My Tho pier court
seoDescription: The Tiền Giang provincial portal names sò at the Mỹ Tho pier court and prints no species. The 2019 clock is 18:30–02:00. The price is Check on arrival.
